title: Blue Circles Over Hills
description: A person sees many blue circles of different sizes floating across the upper part of the picture. Below them are rolling hills covered in green and yellow fields with dark trees under a swirling red orange and yellow sky with a small yellow sun near the middle.
prompt: a finished painting showing many solid blue circles of different sizes floating across the top half over a swirling background of red orange and yellow brush strokes with a small yellow sun near the center the bottom half shows rolling hills covered in patches of green and golden yellow fields with dark clusters of trees
